lines.text: Why does Rheingau Riesling face south?
lines.phonemes: wˌaɪ dˈʌz ɹˈaɪnɡaʊ ɹˈiːslɪŋ fˈeɪs sˈaʊθ?

lines.text: Over three thousand hectares of vines, and a hundred and twenty single vineyards.
lines.phonemes: ˌəʊvə θɹˈiː θˈaʊzənd hˈɛkteəz ɒv vˈaɪnz, and ɐ hˈʌndɹɪd and twˈɛnti sˈɪŋɡəl vˈɪnjədz.

lines.text: Here the Rhine flows west, so its north bank faces the sun.
lines.phonemes: hˈiə ðə ɹˈaɪn flˈəʊz wˈɛst, sˌəʊ ɪts nˈɔːθ bˈaŋk fˈeɪsɪz ðə sˈʌn.

lines.text: Ten point eight percent of the vines grow on slopes of thirty percent or more.
lines.phonemes: tˈɛn pˈɔɪnt ˈeɪt pəsˈɛnt ɒvðə vˈaɪnz ɡɹˈəʊ ˌɒn slˈəʊps ɒv θˈɜːti pəsˈɛnt ɔː mˈɔː.

lines.text: From April to October, Geisenheim averages fifteen point seven degrees.
lines.phonemes: fɹɒm ˈeɪpɹəl tʊ ɒktˈəʊbə, ɡˈaɪzənhaɪm ˈavɹɪdʒɪz fˈɪftiːn pˈɔɪnt sˈɛvən dɪɡɹˈiːz.

lines.text: About seventeen hundred hours of sun a year. July alone has two hundred and thirty six.
lines.phonemes: ɐbˌaʊt sˈɛvəntˌiːn hˈʌndɹɪd ˈaʊəz ɒv sˈʌn ɐ jˈiə. dʒuːlˈaɪ ɐlˈəʊn hɐz tˈuː hˈʌndɹɪd and θˈɜːti sˈɪks.

lines.text: Only five hundred and twenty five millimetres of rain fall in a year.
lines.phonemes: ˈəʊnli fˈaɪv hˈʌndɹɪd and twˈɛnti fˈaɪv mˈɪlɪmˌiːtəz ɒv ɹˈeɪn fˈɔːl ɪn ɐ jˈiə.

lines.text: Riesling covers seventy five percent of the vineyards.
lines.phonemes: ɹˈiːslɪŋ kˈʌvəz sˈɛvənti fˈaɪv pəsˈɛnt ɒvðə vˈɪnjədz.

lines.text: Pinot Noir, here called Spätburgunder, comes second.
lines.phonemes: pˈiːnəʊ nwˈɑː, hˈiə kˈɔːld ʃpˈeːtbʊɹɡʊndɐ, kˈʌmz sˈɛkənd.

lines.text: Test yourself. Three questions. Answers in the first comment.
lines.phonemes: tˈɛst jɔːsˈɛlf. θɹˈiː kwˈɛstʃənz. ˈansəz ɪnðə fˈɜːst kˈɒmɛnt.

lines.text: Study it free at open wine atlas dot com.
lines.phonemes: stˈʌdi ɪt fɹˈiː at ˈəʊpən wˈaɪn ˈatləs dˈɒt kˈɒm.
